syncAudience.title: Sync Audience [Beta]
syncAudience.description: Add users to, and remove users from, a Display & Video 360 Customer Match audience. Supports both Contact Info and Mobile Device ID audiences. This action is currently in beta.

syncMode.label: Sync Mode
syncMode.description: When syncing from a database source (Reverse ETL), define the type of database operation that triggers syncs to Display & Video 360. This setting does not apply when syncing a Segment Audience; membership is resolved from the audience event itself and this selection is ignored.

retlOnMappingSave.label: Select or create an audience in Display & Video 360
retlOnMappingSave.description: When saving this mapping, Segment will either create a new Customer Match audience in Display & Video 360 or connect to an existing one.

operation.label: Create a new audience or connect to an existing one?
operation.description: Choose to either create a new Customer Match audience in Display & Video 360, or connect to an audience which already exists there.

advertiserId.label: Advertiser ID
advertiserId.description: The ID of your advertiser, used throughout Display & Video 360. Use this ID when you contact Display & Video 360 support to help our teams locate your specific account.

audienceName.label: Audience Name
audienceName.description: The display name of the audience to create in Display & Video 360.

audienceType.label: Audience Type
audienceType.description: The type of the audience to create.

membershipDurationDays.label: Membership Duration Days
membershipDurationDays.description: The duration in days that an entry remains in the audience after the qualifying event. The set value must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 540.

appId.description: The appId matches with the type of the mobileDeviceIds being uploaded. Required for CUSTOMER_MATCH_DEVICE_ID audiences.

existingAudienceId.label: Existing Audience ID
existingAudienceId.description: The ID of the audience in Display & Video 360 to connect this mapping to.

audienceId.label: Audience ID
audienceId.description: The ID of the audience in Display & Video 360 this mapping is connected to.

advertiserId.label: Advertiser ID
advertiserId.description: The ID of the advertiser which owns the audience.

audienceType.label: Audience Type
audienceType.description: The type of the audience in Display & Video 360.

appId.label: App ID
appId.description: The app ID associated with the mobile device IDs in the audience.

contact_info.label: Contact Info Details
contact_info.description: The contact details used to match the user in Display & Video 360. This field is only used when syncing to a Customer Match Contact Info audience. It is ignored when syncing to a Mobile Device ID audience.

emails.label: Emails
emails.description: The user's email address. A single value, or several separated by commas. If not already hashed, the system will hash them before use.

phoneNumbers.label: Phone Numbers
phoneNumbers.description: The user's phone number in E.164 format. A single value, or several separated by commas. If not already hashed, the system will hash them before use. Use the 'Phone Number Normalization' settings to have Segment convert numbers to E.164 first.

zipCodes.label: ZIP Codes
zipCodes.description: The user's zip code. A single value, or several separated by commas. Zip Code, First Name, Last Name and Country Code must all be provided together. If any of them is missing, none of them are sent, and no error is raised.

firstName.label: First Name
firstName.description: The user's first name. If not already hashed, the system will hash it before use. Zip Code, First Name, Last Name and Country Code must all be provided together. If any of them is missing, none of them are sent, and no error is raised.

lastName.label: Last Name
lastName.description: The user's last name. If not already hashed, the system will hash it before use. Zip Code, First Name, Last Name and Country Code must all be provided together. If any of them is missing, none of them are sent, and no error is raised.

countryCode.label: Country Code
countryCode.description: The user's country, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Zip Code, First Name, Last Name and Country Code must all be provided together. If any of them is missing, none of them are sent, and no error is raised. It is also used as the country for this user's phone numbers when 'Use Country Code From Contact Info Details' is enabled.

mobileDeviceIds.label: Mobile Device IDs
mobileDeviceIds.description: A mobile device ID defining a Customer Match audience member. A single value, or several separated by commas. This field is only used when syncing to a Customer Match Mobile Device ID audience. It is ignored when syncing to a Contact Info audience.

phone_options.label: Phone Number Normalization
phone_options.description: How Segment should treat phone numbers before hashing them. Display & Video 360 only matches a phone number hashed from its E.164 form, so a number sent in any other format is silently unmatched. This field is only used when syncing to a Customer Match Contact Info audience. It is ignored when syncing to a Mobile Device ID audience.

normalization.label: Normalization
normalization.description: What to do with a phone number which is not already in E.164 format. 'Do not normalize' sends it exactly as mapped. 'Normalize' converts it to E.164 where possible and sends anything it cannot convert unchanged. 'Normalize and validate' also drops numbers which are not valid.

choices.label: Do not normalize - send the phone number exactly as mapped
Normalize - convert to E.164 where possible
Normalize and validate - convert to E.164 and drop invalid numbers

useContactInfoCountryCode.label: Use Country Code From Contact Info Details
useContactInfoCountryCode.description: Whether to take the country a user's phone numbers belong to from the Country Code mapped in Contact Info Details. This lets the country vary per user. It is only used for numbers written in a local format, and the Default Country applies whenever it is not populated.

defaultCountryCode.label: Default Country
defaultCountryCode.description: The country these phone numbers belong to, used to convert a number written in a local format. A number starting with + or 00 already states its own country and is converted without this. Without it, a local number cannot be converted, and is sent unchanged or dropped if validation is on.

consent.label: Consent
consent.description: Consent signals for this audience sync. A signal left unset is sent as not specified. Events with consent denied are not sent, as Display & Video 360 rejects any request containing denied consent.

adUserData.label: Ad User Data Consent
adUserData.description: Consent to use the data for advertising purposes.

adPersonalization.label: Ad Personalization Consent
adPersonalization.description: Consent to use the data for ad personalization.

external_id.label: External ID
external_id.description: The ID of the DV360 Audience.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Maximum number of events to include in each batch. Actual batch sizes may be lower.

batch_keys.label: Batch Keys
batch_keys.description: The keys to use for batching the events.
